description.value: Little Pisces is a Japanese-inspired dessert shop serving mochi-batter taiyaki — crispy on the outside, soft and chewy on the inside — alongside soft serve ice cream and specialty café drinks. The shop opened its first location in June 2024 on the second floor of a Lougheed-area plaza in Burnaby, with a rotating menu of creative flavors and a strong community following. A good stop for a sweet break, with pickup and delivery available.

address.value: 4501 North Rd, Unit 202B, Burnaby, BC V3N 4R7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Lougheed location at 4501 North Rd, Unit 202B, Burnaby, BC — not North Vancouver as OSM community indicates. The website explicitly states vegan soft serve and dairy-free options are available on the menu, and confirms pickup and delivery ordering. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but the business is located in Burnaby, BC (Lougheed area) per the website.
Phone number +1-604-706-5876 is from OSM only; website content does not list a phone number for independent confirmation.
Location is on the second floor of a plaza (per website: 'Second floor of the plaza'), which may limit quick access for loaded touring cyclists.
OSM tag payment:cash=no indicates cash is not accepted — cyclists should be aware.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible dessert business with confirmed website and active menu. A legitimate refreshment stop for cyclists in the Lougheed area.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website states: 'Our dairy-free and vegan options are indicated on our menu. We usually have at least one vegan soft serve option. Most of our drinks can be made with oat milk upon request.'
